params.1273: Craft a pair of leather gloves.
params.1274: To make a pair of gloves you will need one piece of leather, a needle and some thread.
params.1275: Ellis can tan cowhide into leather for you in Al Kharid.
params.1276: The needle and thread can be bought from a crafting shop such as Dommik's.
params.2225: Making leather goods grants Crafting experience; a high Crafting level lets you make a wide range of useful goods.
